messages.content: You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
If I use points for an upgrade but pay some cash as well, can I expense the cash portion?
No, any portion of a cash upgrade is non-reimbursable according to Section 5, even if part was covered by points.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Is the per-diem for meals different if I'm traveling within the US versus to Europe?
Yes, the per-diem is $75/day for domestic trips and $95/day for international trips, as specified in Section 4.3.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
My international trip is $4,000 for 4 nights. What approval do I need?
The 4+ nights international cap is $3,500 (Section 3). At $4,000 you are over by about 14%, so VP approval is needed (CFO approval is required only when over by more than 15%).
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Is the spa charge at my hotel reimbursable?
No. Personal entertainment including spa charges is non-reimbursable (Section 5).
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
If I lose an itemized receipt for a $35 dinner, can I still get reimbursed?
No, all expenses of $25 or more require itemized receipts for reimbursement. See Section 9.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
I found my hotel receipt from three months ago—can I still submit it for reimbursement?
Reimbursement after 60 days requires VP approval and a written exception; otherwise, it is not allowed. See Section 9.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
I'm taking a customer to dinner. Is the wine reimbursable?
Yes — alcohol is reimbursable in approved client entertainment up to $150 per person with itemized receipt and attendee list (Section 8).
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
If I submit my airport parking receipt 40 days after my trip, will I still be reimbursed?
Receipts must be submitted within 30 days of your trip return for airport parking reimbursement (Section 4.2).
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Can I expense the cost of boarding my dog while I'm traveling for business?
No, pet boarding is considered a non-reimbursable personal expense per Section 5.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Can I book first class for a 12-hour international flight?
No. First class is never reimbursable, regardless of flight length (Section 7.1). Business class is allowed for flights over 6 hours with VP approval.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Can I get reimbursed for hotel Wi-Fi if I use my own hotspot instead?
No, Section 4.4 only covers hotel Wi-Fi charges, not personal hotspot expenses.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
What happens if I submit my receipts more than 60 days after my trip?
If you submit after 60 days, reimbursement requires VP approval and a written exception as stated in Section 9.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Can I book premium economy for a 7-hour international flight?
Yes, premium economy is permitted for flights that are 6 hours or longer. See Section 7.1.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Is travel insurance I bought separately reimbursable?
No. WWI provides travel insurance, so independently purchased insurance is non-reimbursable (Section 5).
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
If my total trip cost is $500 over the cap but I forgot to get VP approval, will my expenses still be reimbursed?
No, exceeding the budget cap requires advance VP (≤15% over) or CFO (>15% over) approval. See Section 3.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Can I expense pet boarding while I travel for work?
No. Pet boarding is explicitly listed as non-reimbursable under Section 5.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
What's the per-diem for meals on a domestic trip?
$75 per day for domestic travel (Section 4.3). Alcohol is excluded except for approved client entertainment.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
How far ahead do I need to book my international business trip?
International trips must be booked at least 21 days in advance (Section 2).
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Are contractors covered by the 7-day advance booking policy for domestic travel?
No, contractors must use the contractor-travel workflow, which is not covered by this policy (Section 1).
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
What's the maximum I can spend per person when taking clients out to dinner?
You may spend up to $150 per person for meals and drinks with clients, according to Section 8.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Can I expense the minibar at my hotel?
No. Personal entertainment items including minibar are non-reimbursable under Section 5.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
How long in advance must I book an international trip?
At least 21 days in advance, per Section 2. Exceptions require manager and travel-ops approval.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Can I book a hotel in London for $390 per night if my VP approves it?
Yes, for Tier 1 cities like London, VP approval is required if the rate is more than 20% over the $325/night cap (Section 6).
